method: Freshly checked every existing profile against official public documentation/HTML before discovery, comparing rates, clocks, applicability and published dates against the repository. Source excerpts used for the previous audit were not treated as today's verification. All 32 profiles are covered: 25 fully reverified, five partial, one route-unverified, and one operator-disabled personal timer. Partial/unverified/disabled verifiedAt dates remain unchanged. This validates public terms, not paid-account bills. Changes use a temporary worktree from fetched origin/main; the saved checkout is untouched.
summary: Add an explicit policy notice for Baidu Qianfan V4 Pro 0813 cached-input pricing. Current model label publishes September 9–October 30; its year, exact cutoff, time zone and subsequent cache prices are not specified. No fabricated timed price transition is added.

Z.ai's overview no longer displays the expired Sep 25–Oct 7 all-day promotion. The separate Flash campaign document still ends October 7. Existing dated overrides already expire correctly and need no schedule change.

All active schedules and current multipliers otherwise match main. DeepSeek and B.AI Saturday October 10 remain off-peak even though China calls it a makeup working day; provider definitions specify Monday–Friday.

No new clock-compatible provider with sufficiently precise official evidence. Hunyuan/Swarms Frenzy remain insufficiently timed; Novita queued off_peak mode and fixed preemptible compute are not wall-clock API discounts.
Commit on the dated automation branch only; no merge, push or deployment. Remove temporary worktree after commit while retaining branch.
uncertainties: DeepSeek table still lists separate Pro 0813 pricing while its September 10 routing announcement says Pro requests route to Flash until a future V4.1 Pro launch; current Pro scope remains unverified.
AIHubMix aggregate schedule/rates differ from named routes and automatic fallback is documented; no universal schedule or weekend/holiday rule can be guaranteed.
Z.ai's expired Flash campaign did not specify the final October 7 overnight cutoff. Historical interpretation is retained, not newly certified.
Tencent October 31 Flash 0731 retirement notice does not explicitly cover Vendor Direct; do not assume coverage.
SiliconFlow Hunyuan daily 09:00–18:00 price split lacks a confirmed time zone; no inferred provider added.
Swarms Black Friday free-request promotion lacks a published exact time-zone/start instant; not encoded.
Chinese holiday exceptions cover 2026 only. Do not infer them for other providers. No settled-account pricing verification performed.

Baidu busy/idle time zone remains unstated. The Pro 0813 cache-price date label says September 9–October 30 without a year, exact cutoff or subsequent rates; these gaps are explicitly exposed rather than filled in.
